description: Ministry of National Policies and Economic Affairs - Foreign Exchange Regulations (Sorry, there was an error in the english document and the corrected document appears)
categorisation: This gazette contains regulations made under the Foreign Exchange Act, No. 12 of 2017, establishing legal frameworks for capital transactions in foreign exchange. It outlines regulatory requirements, compliance procedures, and authorized activities for financial institutions, falling squarely under Legal/Regulatory matters (Type 5). While it mentions a minister's name (Ranil Wickremesinghe), it does not describe his portfolio responsibilities in detail, so it does not qualify as a Hybrid gazette. The content is primarily about establishing legal/regulatory frameworks rather than government personnel or structure.
